source_selection.selection: the complete single retained JSON document

json_contract.unknown_or_missing_keys: reject; exact keys and source key order are required
json_contract.array_order: preserve source order and each parent/ordinal; never sort or deduplicate
json_contract.chapter_and_verse_numbers: positive consecutive JSON integers in source array order; booleans are not integers
json_contract.text_values: nonempty strings only; preserve exact Unicode scalar sequences, leading/trailing whitespace, and literal characters without parsing or normalization
json_contract.empty_arrays: reject at every declared books/chapters/verses collection

mapping.translation: Copy /translation verbatim to a TEI source-description bibl labeled as a retained source label; do not infer edition, date, translator, or work boundary.
mapping.book: One TEI book div per source book object, in source array order; source name is the head text and is not mapped through a separate Bible-name table.
mapping.chapter: One TEI chapter div per source chapter object, in source array order; preserve the exact numeric label.
mapping.verse: One TEI ab per source verse object, in source array order; preserve the exact numeric label and decoded text value.
mapping.xml_space: Set xml:space=preserve on every verse ab so the mapping remains explicit even though this source has no boundary whitespace carriers.
mapping.tei_title: Use the generic candidate title; retain the source translation label separately without promoting it to verified bibliographic identity.
mapping.source_note: Place the limitation notice in a notesStmt note; keep sourceDesc limited to the source-supplied translation label.

required_inventory: source member path, byte count, and SHA-256
source selector and exact translation field value
all 1,189 ordered chapter carriers with their verse counts
all 31,102 ordered verse carriers with parent position, exact label, text state, and exact text-value SHA-256
accountability.independent_comparison: The oracle separately reads the retained JSON, derives its own complete ledger, validates the ledger schema, and compares the actual TEI tree directly with source order and values.

downstream_segmentation.role: diagnostic only; not a source authority, selector, producer input, oracle input, or completeness oracle
downstream_segmentation.warning: The generated per-book projection normalizes 18 display labels. A generated completeness label does not alter this policy.

identity_and_rights.work_id: webster is the pre-existing route key only; broader work boundary remains unresolved
identity_and_rights.edition_and_lineage: unresolved; do not interpret the retained label or config note as independently verified edition evidence
identity_and_rights.rights_and_attribution: not assessed; the legacy config's rights label is not adopted as proof

shared_assumptions: Python's JSON decoder, with duplicate-key rejection independently applied in each route
manifest-bound source bytes and the shared SourceManifest contract
the declared TEI P5 schema and its local XML schema imports
the shared final MechanicalFacts attestation assembler

candidate.title: Retained Bible translation text
candidate.publication_notice: Source-bound reconstruction output only; this route makes no acceptance, rights, release, or publication claim.
candidate.source_note: The exact retained translation label is source-supplied metadata. It is preserved as a label only, not asserted as resolved edition or publication evidence.
candidate.scope: The complete ordered envelope of the one exact retained JSON member; not a complete-print or bibliographic-witness claim.
candidate.readme:
# Webster retained-source reconstruction route

This route is bound to the complete retained JSON document `raw/bible_databases/formats/json/Webster.json` (SHA-256 `12b70533fcc01b5bad9d704af348617208a525f4ed2fbaf869736e83ef352f6a`). It preserves the source's `translation` field, ordered books, chapters, verse carriers, and exact text values. The legacy per-book JSON projection is diagnostic only and is not reconstruction authority.

The retained label and legacy config note are not independent evidence of edition identity or date. Work boundary, textual form, rights, and source lineage remain unresolved or unassessed. This technical route does not establish human acceptance, release, or publication authorization.

unresolved.question: Does this exact retained JSON scope establish the same standalone work and translation/textual form as the existing webster catalog route key?
What bibliographic edition and digital lineage, if any, are established by primary-source evidence beyond the retained translation label and config note?
Which work-specific evidence supports translator attribution for this exact retained text?
What rights and attribution terms apply separately to the underlying work, translation, edition, transcription, database, and retained source?
Coordinator review, exact-pair visual review, and any human acceptance decision remain separate future work.

mutation_cases_rejected: reorder or duplicate a book, chapter, or verse carrier
invent a carrier or change a numeric label
alter, trim, normalize, or replace any exact verse string
alter or omit the retained translation label
candidate_packaging: The coordinator owns candidate packaging through the supported reconstruct_candidate CLI.
